title: AI Data Analyst
desc: Ask questions about uploaded CSV and Excel data in natural language and receive AI-assisted analysis.
purpose: Ask questions about uploaded CSV and Excel data in natural language and receive AI-assisted analysis.
features: Preview rows and inspect column names
Basic type conversion and date parsing
Use DuckDB SQL and Pandas tools through an Agno agent
Display the agent response in Streamlit
workflow: Upload dataset → Prepare data → Ask a question → AI agent uses data tools → View answer
limitations: Requires an OpenAI API key and internet access. It performs basic preprocessing, not full data cleaning. It does not currently include a dedicated visualization dashboard, downloadable reports, or automated model training.

title: Automated File Organizer & Batch PDF Report Generator
desc: Sort files into extension-based folders and produce a PDF inventory report with a reversible move record.
purpose: Sort files into extension-based folders and produce a PDF inventory report with a reversible move record.
features: Preview planned file moves with dry-run mode
Organize local folders through CLI or uploaded files through Streamlit
Save a JSON manifest for undo
Generate PDF summary with category totals and file details
workflow: Select source files → Preview organization plan → Move into categories → Save undo manifest → Generate PDF report
limitations: Review the preview before applying file moves. Test on copies of important files first.

title: Credit Scoring Machine Learning
desc: Demonstrate an educational credit-risk classification workflow using applicant data and a Random Forest model.
purpose: Demonstrate an educational credit-risk classification workflow using applicant data and a Random Forest model.
features: Train and evaluate a Random Forest classifier
Explore results in a Streamlit interface
workflow: Load applicant data → Prepare features → Train Random Forest → Evaluate model → Predict risk category
limitations: Uses synthetic sample data. It is an educational demonstration and must not be used for real loan decisions or financial advice.

title: Customer Insight Pro
desc: Explore customer churn patterns and estimate customer-level churn risk through an interactive dashboard.
purpose: Explore customer churn patterns and estimate customer-level churn risk through an interactive dashboard.
workflow: Load customer data → Explore churn KPIs → Filter customer records → Score a customer → Review evaluation metrics
limitations: The repository documents demo-data and model limitations. Risk scores are model estimates, not guarantees about an individual customer.

title: Interactive Data Visualization Dashboard
desc: Turn sales records into interactive business summaries, charts, filters, and downloadable data.
purpose: Turn sales records into interactive business summaries, charts, filters, and downloadable data.
features: Calculate revenue, units sold, and order KPIs
Explore daily revenue trends and export filtered CSV
workflow: Load sales CSV → Choose region filter → Calculate KPIs → Explore charts → Export filtered data
limitations: The included sales figures are illustrative sample data, not actual company performance.

title: Disease Prediction from Medical Data
desc: Demonstrate a machine learning classification workflow using structured sample health-related attributes.
purpose: Demonstrate a machine learning classification workflow using structured sample health-related attributes.
features: Review model metrics and visual summaries
workflow: Load sample records → Prepare features → Train classifier → Evaluate results → Explore prediction
limitations: Synthetic data and predictions are educational only. This project is not suitable for diagnosis, treatment, or clinical decisions.

title: Handwritten Digit Recognition
desc: Classify handwritten digits from image pixel features using a Scikit-learn neural-network classifier.
purpose: Classify handwritten digits from image pixel features using a Scikit-learn neural-network classifier.
features: Convert image pixels into numerical feature vectors
Display sample digit images and results
workflow: Load digit images → Flatten pixel values → Train MLP classifier → Evaluate predictions → Display digit results
limitations: The included Scikit-learn digits dataset uses 8×8 images of digits 0 to 9. It is not full alphabet recognition or production OCR.

title: NLP Sentiment Analysis
desc: Classify text reviews into sentiment labels using TF-IDF features and Logistic Regression.
purpose: Classify text reviews into sentiment labels using TF-IDF features and Logistic Regression.
features: Display classification report and test accuracy
workflow: Load labelled reviews → Vectorize text → Train classifier → Evaluate model → Predict new review
limitations: The repository uses short synthetic review examples. Results should not be treated as representative public opinion.

title: Personal Expense & Budget Management App
desc: Record personal income and expenses, set monthly category budgets, and review balances in a Flask web app.
purpose: Record personal income and expenses, set monthly category budgets, and review balances in a Flask web app.
features: Assign category, date, and optional description
Create or update monthly category budgets
View monthly income, expenses, and remaining balance
Store records with SQLAlchemy and SQLite by default
workflow: Record transaction → Save to database → Set monthly budgets → Review monthly balance → Export CSV
limitations: The current app has no login or user-level data separation. Add authentication, CSRF protection, secure configuration, and persistent backups before using real sensitive financial data.

title: Basic Rule-Based Chatbot
desc: Create a simple command-line chatbot that matches user messages to predefined rules and returns conversational replies.
purpose: Create a simple command-line chatbot that matches user messages to predefined rules and returns conversational replies.
workflow: Enter message → Normalize text → Match a rule → Return response → Continue or exit
limitations: This is a rule-based chatbot. It does not use an LLM or generate open-ended AI responses.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis Dashboard
desc: Inspect uploaded tabular data, summarize columns, check data quality, and explore distributions and correlations.
purpose: Inspect uploaded tabular data, summarize columns, check data quality, and explore distributions and correlations.
features: Inspect dataset shape, columns, and data types
Display analysis in a Streamlit dashboard
workflow: Upload CSV → Inspect structure → Check data quality → Review statistics → Explore charts
limitations: Analysis depends on the quality and representativeness of the uploaded dataset. Correlation does not establish causation.

title: Python Hangman Game
desc: Build a command-line word guessing game to practise Python fundamentals and input handling.
purpose: Build a command-line word guessing game to practise Python fundamentals and input handling.
workflow: Choose random word → Show hidden letters → Enter a guess → Update game state → Win or lose
limitations: The game uses a predefined word list unless the source is extended with additional word sources or difficulty options.

title: Web Scraping with Python and BeautifulSoup
desc: Retrieve permitted public webpage HTML and extract structured information such as headings and links.
purpose: Retrieve permitted public webpage HTML and extract structured information such as headings and links.
features: Send an HTTP request with Requests
workflow: Enter public URL → Fetch HTML → Parse document → Extract headings and links → Review results
limitations: Scrape only pages where automated access is permitted. Respect terms of service, robots.txt, rate limits, copyright, and privacy requirements.

title: Spam Message Guard
desc: Classify text messages as spam or genuine using TF-IDF text features and a Multinomial Naive Bayes model.
purpose: Classify text messages as spam or genuine using TF-IDF text features and a Multinomial Naive Bayes model.
features: Show evaluation metrics and confusion matrix
Present model limitations and safety guidance
workflow: Load labelled messages → Vectorize text → Train Naive Bayes → Evaluate classifier → Test a new message
limitations: This is a demonstration classifier. Do not rely on it as the only control for security-sensitive message filtering.

title: Speech Emotion Recognition
desc: Explore audio feature processing for emotion-classification experiments using numerical speech features.
purpose: Explore audio feature processing for emotion-classification experiments using numerical speech features.
features: Use MFCC-style numerical features where implemented
Display demonstration analysis or classifier output
workflow: Prepare audio features → Extract numerical values → Build feature vectors → Run demonstration analysis → Review output
limitations: The repository describes illustrative feature rows. Reliable emotion recognition requires real labelled audio, careful validation, and attention to speaker and recording differences.

title: Stock Portfolio Tracker
desc: Calculate estimated holding values and total portfolio value from symbols, quantities, and CSV reference prices.
purpose: Calculate estimated holding values and total portfolio value from symbols, quantities, and CSV reference prices.
features: Read sample stock prices from CSV
workflow: Load price CSV → Enter holdings → Match symbols → Calculate holding values → Sum portfolio value
limitations: Prices are static sample values unless a live market data provider is integrated. This is not investment advice or live market data.

title: Python Task Automation Toolkit
desc: Bundle small Python utilities for organizing image files, extracting email-like strings, and saving webpage titles.
purpose: Bundle small Python utilities for organizing image files, extracting email-like strings, and saving webpage titles.
features: Move JPG and JPEG files into an organized folder
Extract unique email-like strings from text files
Save extracted strings to a text file
Fetch a public webpage and save its title
Handle common file and request errors
workflow: Choose a utility → Provide input → Process files or webpage → Save output → Review result
limitations: Test file operations on copies. Extracted email-like strings are not verified addresses or consent to contact. Respect website access rules.

title: Automated Web Scraper & Price Tracker
desc: Collect product prices from permitted public pages, store dated observations in SQLite, and visualize price history.
purpose: Collect product prices from permitted public pages, store dated observations in SQLite, and visualize price history.
features: Configure product URLs and CSS selectors
Use request timeouts and configurable delays
View history table and line chart in Streamlit
Run from CLI using JSON configuration
workflow: Configure product page → Fetch permitted HTML → Parse title and price → Store timestamped record → View trend and export CSV
limitations: Check website terms and robots.txt. This Requests-based tool may not read JavaScript-rendered prices. It does not run on a built-in background schedule.

title: Ali Umair Group — Shop Management System
desc: Manage multiple shops, staff roles, stock, sales, customer khata, expenses, and daily reports from one private web application.
purpose: Manage multiple shops, staff roles, stock, sales, customer khata, expenses, and daily reports from one private web application.
features: Owner, manager, and worker role-based access
Create and manage multiple shop locations
Manage products, stock, and sale prices
Record cash and credit sales with stock updates
Maintain customer khata credit and payment entries
Track shop expenses and daily reports
Responsive interface with Urdu layout preview
workflow: Sign in by role → Select authorized shop → Manage stock and customers → Record sales and expenses → Review khata and reports
limitations: The Urdu toggle is a layout preview, not a complete translation. Reports show sales minus expenses, not net profit. Review security and production configuration before public deployment.
